message.content: Hunting for a physics break — starting with high-energy close encounters.
That head-on pass held together — now trying off-center slingshots to stress the integrator.
Direct collisions are stable — testing chaotic three-body and heavy-light slingshots.
Two-body head-ons pass, so I'll try a heavy central mass whipping a light body at max speed.
A light body flying past a heavy mass just broke momentum conservation — shrinking to a minimal case.
Shrunk to a clean two-body case — confirming it replays deterministically.
Replay confirmed — now inspecting the states around the violation to pin down the cause.
Violation isolated at step 10 — checking the initial and pre-violation states.
Step 9 conserves momentum perfectly but step 10 jumps — testing whether a smaller timestep removes it.
A finer timestep eliminates the violation — submitting the grounded report.
